Interior Design Outside Florida: East Coast & Online

Our core work is in South Florida, but we also take select projects along the East Coast and design online for clients anywhere. Remote projects run the same way as local ones: video meetings, a complete design with shopping lists and vendor links, coordination with your local contractor and a written update every Friday. When a project needs it, we plan site trips in advance.

New York

Interior Designer New York

We work with vendors in New York and have completed a furnishing project there. New York projects are taken selectively – furnishing and e-design, and other projects by request.

For homes in North Carolina, we offer e-design and select furnishing projects – tell us about your home and we’ll recommend the right format.

Service Area FAQ

01Do you work in my city?

If you live between Miami and West Palm Beach, yes – we offer every service on site across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. Use the “Check your area” search above or send us your ZIP code, and we will confirm which services are available at your address.

02Do you travel for projects in New York or North Carolina?

Yes, for select projects. We take furnishing work and larger residential projects in New York and North Carolina, and plan site trips around key milestones. Between visits we coordinate with your local contractor by video and send a written update every Friday.

03How often do you visit the site during a project?

As often as the stage requires. During concept work most time is spent in the studio; once construction, ordering and installation start, Anastasia spends several days a week at showrooms, vendors and job sites. Every visit is reflected in your Friday report.

04Can you work with clients who live out of state but own a home in Florida?

Yes, and many owners prefer it this way. We meet by video, you approve key decisions remotely, and we manage the contractor, vendors and deliveries on site. You don’t need to fly in – the Friday report shows exactly what was done and what needs your decision.

05Do you offer interior design online?

Yes. E-design is available for any location: we meet by video, review your photos and measurements, and deliver a layout, moodboard, 3D views and a shopping list with vendor links. You or your local contractor carry out the plan, and you can upgrade to full service later.
